name: fx-repeat-swing
about: Designed in Session 16 and worked by hand before any code (ENGINE.md section 17). A pattern of eight steps at 120 bpm with swing 24, the lane set by edits: effect 10 (the repeat at three a beat, every 128 ticks) on steps 2 to 5. Sound 1 is on steps 1, 2 and 3, its step 2 at probability 70; sound 3 on steps 2 and 6; sound 2 on step 4 and taken out of the effects. The run begins at step 2, an odd grid step: its first hit is on the step's tick 0, not swung, and its next two fall 128 and 256 ticks on, inside steps 3 and 4, carrying step 2's number. Four steps hold three hits, not four. Sound 1's own step 3 is silent under the run; sound 2 plays its own step 4, swung. Every repeated hit of sound 1's step 2 takes a draw, in time and before sound 3 in the same tick: 69 fires, 89 does not, 61 fires in the first pass; 95 does not, 33 and 4 fire in the second. After the run the beat comes back in place: sound 3's step 6 is swung.
